hero.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian woman only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion.

Janmashtami 2026 candid lifestyle photograph, mid-shot of people (not a product ad). A fair-skinned Indian woman in a soft yellow festive saree smiles during a home Janmashtami evening with warm aarti lamps and marigold flowers softly blurred behind her. Faces and upper body fill most of the frame. She is physically wearing the rose gold heart pendant from (@img1, @img2) on a fine rose gold cable chain. The Valeria Rose Pendant rests on her upper chest with a soft contact shadow, natural necklace size (about 2 to 3 cm heart, small in frame). Camera focuses on the person; jewellery sharp but NOT the largest object. Design fidelity: rose gold heart, right-side pave diamonds, left-side open triple rose gold bands. ONLY jewellery. Bare ears and wrists. CRITICAL: attached to body, never floating packshot overlay. 16:9, safe margins.

lifestyle.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian woman only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion.

higgsfield.people_theme_anchor: Photoreal candid lifestyle photograph, natural skin texture, no illustration, no CGI. Soft natural window light, warm daylight, realistic soft shadows, gentle shallow depth of field. Shot on DSLR, 16:9 full frame with safe margins. People are the primary subject; jewellery is a small worn detail on the body, not a floating product graphic. Entire faces and worn jewellery fully visible, nothing cropped at frame edges.
higgsfield.product_theme_anchor: Photoreal product-in-scene jewellery photograph, HD quality, no distortion of jewellery, identical scale and design, physically accurate metal and stone detail, natural textures only, no stylization, no illustration. Soft natural window light, warm daylight, realistic soft shadows, shallow depth of field. Shot on DSLR, 16:9 full frame with safe margins. Entire jewellery fully visible, nothing cropped at frame edges.
